title: The rust outside row pushes its base and says why when it cannot
body:
Source: outside rust row 1115l on 79daa4c/ed2a8f0 (summary.txt row "rust | 1 | none | not run ... push of the orphan base failed")
Why: the rust row never adopted: pushing its orphan base to krn-works/krn outside/rust failed, and the row note keeps no git error text, so the cause is unknown (earlier the same message came from two rows of one stack pushing at once; this run had one rust row).
Outcome: the row note carries the git push stderr, and the rust row ends with adopt exit 0 and drain exit 0.
Files: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts, test/scripts/outside-acceptance.test.ts
Proof: `node --test test/scripts/outside-acceptance.test.ts`
Rerun 1115n: the rust row pushed its orphan base (push error not reproduced; one row, no concurrent pushes), adopt exit 0, but drain exit 74 and hidden fail (merged 5ff3870, fix 8ebf822); the drain failure is a separate defect for a new task.
Predicted: outside adopt == 0 in >= 1 rows
